t1_t5.reading: Vision (H2377[v]) belonging to Obadiah (H5662R[v]). Thus says (H0559[v], Qal perf 3ms) the Lord God (H0136[v]/H3069[v]) concerning Edom (H0123G[v]). We have heard (H8085G[bf], Qal perf 1cp) a report (H8052[v]) from the Lord (H3068G[v]); a messenger has been sent (H7971G[bf], Pual perf 3ms, passive, agent unstated) among the nations (H1471A[bf]): Rise up (H6965J[v], Qal impv 2mp) let us rise (H6965J[v], Qal inf.cs + 1cp cohortative) against her for battle (H4421[v]).

readings: prophet + coalition of nations (adopted -- grounded in the 1cp cohortative 'let us rise' at span 15)
stylized collective, no specific referential intent

open_naming_gaps.note: passive, agent unstated, no candidate to weigh -- single unnamed referent, not a crux

t3_flags.note: Pual perfect passive (HVPp3ms), sent -- agent not encoded in the verb form

t5_genre_absences: no call/commissioning narrative (contrast Isa 6, Ezek 1-3, Jer 1)

t1_t5.reading: Behold (H2009[v]) -- I will make (H5414I[bf], Qal perf 1cs) you (H0859A[v], 2ms) small (H6996B[v]) among the nations (H1471A[bf]); you shall be utterly (H3966[v]) despised (H0959[v], Qal passive participle -- durative, 'is continually despised', not a simple future).

open_naming_gaps.note: not yet named, single grammatically-clear referent, no competing candidates

t3_flags.note: H0959 passive participle -- durative aspect diverges from translation's simple future 'shall be despised'

t1_t5.reading: The pride (H2087[v]) of your heart (H3820A[bf]) has deceived (H5377[v], Qal perf 3ms) you, who live (H7931[v], Qal active ptc msc) in the clefts (H2288[v]) of the rock (H5553H[v]), in your lofty (H4791[v]) dwelling (H7675[v]), who say (H0559[v], Qal active ptc msa + 3ms suffix 'his heart') Who (H4310[v]) will bring [me] down (H3381[v], Hiphil impf 3ms) to the ground (H0776H[v]).

t3_flags.note: 'say' carries a 3ms possessive suffix ('his heart') diverging from the 2ms suffixes used earlier in the same verse ('your heart', 'deceived you') -- recorded as-is, not normalized

t1_t5.reading: Though you soar aloft (H1361[v], Hiphil impf 2ms) like the eagle (H5404[v]), though your nest is set (H7760A[bf], Qal passive ptc, durative) among the stars (H3556[v]), from there I will bring you down (H3381[v], Hiphil impf 1cs), declares (H5002[v]) the Lord (H3068G[v]) -- first explicit naming of the speaker running since v2.

t2_flags.note: own tagged variant range spans both literal-height and figurative-arrogance senses -- genuinely ambiguous within this verse alone, neither excluded by morph; named, not resolved

t1_t5.reading: Two rhetorical hypotheticals (H0518A[v]): if thieves (H1590[v]) came (H0935G[bf], Qal perf 3cp) to you, if plunderers (H7703[v]) came by night (H3915[v]) -- how you have been destroyed! (H1820[v], Niphal perf 2ms, passive) -- would they not steal (H1589[v]) only enough for themselves (H1767[v])? If grape gatherers (H1219[v]) came (H0935G[bf], same lexeme), would they not leave (H7604[v]) gleanings (H5955[v])?

open_naming_gaps.note: no new naming info this verse

t3_flags.note: H1820 Niphal perfect 2ms -- passive voice, addressee acted upon

t1_t5.reading: How Esau (H6215H[v], person/lineage sense -- explicitly named for the first time since v1's 'Edom') has been pillaged (H2664[v], Niphal perf 3cp, passive), his treasures (H4710[v]) sought out (H1158[v], Niphal perf 3cp, passive).

All your allies (H0582[v]+H1285[v], lit. 'men of your covenant') have driven you (H7971G[bf], same lexeme as v1 'sent', here Piel perf 3cp) to your border (H1366G[v]); those at peace with you (H7965G[bf]) have deceived you (H5377[v], same lexeme as v3); they have prevailed (H3201[v]); those who eat your bread (H3899H[v]) have set (H7760A[bf], same lexeme as v4) a trap (H4204[v]) beneath you (H8478G[v]); you have no (H0369[v]) understanding (H8394[v]).

open_naming_gaps.note: not re-named this verse (last named 'Esau', v6)
described by relation only, not by proper name

t1_t5.reading: Will I not on that day -- declares (H5002[v]) the Lord (H3068G[v]) -- destroy (H0006[v], Hiphil 1cs) the wise men (H2450[v]) out of Edom (H0123G[v]), and understanding (H8394[v], same faculty flagged in v7) out of Mount Esau (H2022G[v]+H6215I[v], place-sense, distinct tagged entry from H6215H's person-sense in v6).

Your mighty men (H1368[v]) shall be dismayed (H2865[v], Qal perf 3cp), O Teman (H8487H[v], named region, 2ms suffix) so that every man (H0376I[v]) from Mount Esau (H2022G+H6215I, place-sense, matching v8) will be cut off (H3772I[v], Niphal jussive 3ms, passive) by slaughter (H6993[v]).

readings: toponym standing in for its human inhabitants
location distinct from any named human party
referent_cruxes.adopted: not resolved -- both grammatically live, Hebrew regularly personifies place-names as addressees without formally marking the shift
referent_cruxes.note: bears directly on the T6 stamp decision for this word

t1_t5.reading: Because of the violence (H2555[v]) done to your brother (H0251G[v]) Jacob (H3290[v], first human proper name besides Edom/Esau/Obadiah), shame (H0955[v]) shall cover you (H3680[v], Piel impf 3fs, 'shame' as subject), and you shall be cut off (H3772I[v], Niphal perf 2ms, passive) forever (H5769G[v]).

open_naming_gaps.note: not named by proper name -- only the kinship claim ('your brother Jacob') supplies a name, and it names the victim, not the addressee

t1_t5.reading: On the day that you stood (H5975G[bf], Qal inf.cs -- no independent person marking, 2ms subject carried by a separate suffix span) aloof, on the day that strangers (H2114A[bf]) carried off (H7617[v]) his wealth (H2428H[bf]) and foreigners (H5237[v]) entered (H0935G[bf], same lexeme as v5) his gates and cast lots (H3032[v]/H1486[v]) for Jerusalem (H3389[v], named) -- you were like one of them (H0259[v]).

readings: an unnamed masculine collective/people (e.g. Jacob/house of Israel) -- adopted, grounded in Jerusalem (fem.) being the object of the lot-casting, not its own antecedent
loose/extended agreement with 'Jerusalem' itself despite grammatical gender mismatch

t3_flags.note: 'stood' is Qal infinitive construct (HVqcc) -- carries no person/number of its own; the 2ms subject comes from a separate suffixed span (H9041), not from this verb form

t1_t5.reading: Three-part prohibition: do not gloat (H7200G[bf], Qal jussive 2ms) over the day of your brother (H0251G[v]) in the day of his misfortune (H5235[v]); do not rejoice (H8055[v], Qal jussive 2ms) over the people (H1121G[bf]) of Judah (H3063G[bf], first explicit naming of the wronged party by proper name) in the day of their ruin (H0006[v]); do not boast (H6310G[v]+H1431[v], idiom, Hiphil jussive 2ms) in the day of distress (H6869B[bf]).

open_naming_gaps.note: not itself named within this verse

t1_t5.note: 'Judah' here independently resolves the v11 open crux ('his wealth/gates') -- v12 supplies its own naming, not borrowed from v11

t1_t5.reading: Do not enter (H0935G[bf], same lexeme as vv5/11) the gate (H8179G[v]) of my people (H5971A[bf], 1cs possessive -- speaker claims direct ownership) in the day of their calamity (H0343[v]); do not gloat (H7200G[bf], same lexeme/morph as v12) over his disaster (H7451C[bf]) in the day of his calamity; do not loot (H7971G[bf], same lexeme as vv1/7, idiom 'stretch out the hand', Qal jussive 2fp) his wealth (H2428H[bf], same lexeme as v11).

open_naming_gaps.note: not nameable from this verse alone
same unnamed masculine referent as v11 -- not re-litigated, carried as the same crux

t3_flags.note: 'loot' is Qal jussive 2fp (2nd person FEMININE PLURAL) -- diverges from the 2ms singular addressee used everywhere else in vv2-12 and v14; recorded as-is, not normalized

t1_t5.reading: Do not stand (H5975G[bf], same lexeme as v11 'stood', here Qal jussive 2ms -- a different morphological shape from v11's infinitive construct) at the crossroads (H6563[v]) to cut off (H3772I[v]) his fugitives (H6412A[v]); do not hand over (H5462[v], idiom, Hiphil jussive 2ms) his survivors (H8300[v]) in the day of distress (H6869B[bf], same lexeme as v12).

open_naming_gaps.note: same unnamed masculine referent as vv11/13, not re-enumerated

t1_t5.reading: For the day of the Lord (H3068G[v]) is near (H7138[v]) upon all the nations (H1471A[bf]). As you have done (H6213A[bf], Qal perf 2ms, active) it shall be done to you (H6213A[bf], Niphal impf 3ms, passive) -- identical verb root, active then passive, within one verse; your deeds (H1576[v]) shall return (H7725G[bf]) on your own head (H7218A[v]).

open_naming_gaps.note: still unnamed this verse (last named 'Judah', v12, as the wronged party, not the addressee)

t1_t5.reading: For as you have drunk (H8354[v], Qal perf 2mp -- diverges from 2ms used everywhere else in vv2-15) on my holy (H6944G[bf], 1cs possessive) mountain (H2022G[v]), so all the nations (H1471A[bf]) shall drink (H8354[v], Qal impf 3mp) continually (H8548[v]); they shall drink and swallow (H3886A[v]), and shall be (H1961[v]) as though they had never been (H3808[v]).

t3_flags.note: 'drunk' is 2mp -- the only plural-addressee verb form found across the whole passage's 2nd-person material (vv2-15 are uniformly 2ms); not normalized, whether the addressee becomes collective here is not decided

t1_t5.reading: But in Mount Zion (H2022G[v]+H6726[v], named) there shall be (H1961[v], Qal impf 3fs) those who escape (H6413[v]); and it shall be (H1961[v], Qal perf 3ms) holy (H6944G[bf], same lexeme as v16's defiled mountain, here restored); and the house of Jacob (H1004M[v]+H3290[v], named, recurs from v10) shall possess (H3423H[v]) their own possessions (H4180[v]).

The house of Jacob (H1004M+H3290) shall be a fire (H0784[v]), and the house of Joseph (H3130G[v], new to the passage) a flame (H3852[v]), and the house of Esau (H6215H[v], person-sense matching v6, not the place-sense of vv8/9) stubble (H7179[v]); they shall burn (H1814[v], Qal perf 3cp) them and consume (H0398[v], Qal perf 3cp) them, and there shall be no (H3808[v]) survivor (H8300[v]+H1961[v]) for the house of Esau, for the Lord (H3068G[v]) has spoken (H1696G[bf]).
